Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be carried out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The first draft initiated 
by eng. Saady Ahmed Mohamed Yahie, tested by eng. 
Ibrahem Mohamed Abdel Rahman, accepted byeng.Hassan Refaie Hessain general 
director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abd EL-Qader El Nagar, and approved by eng. Fawzy 
Sobhy Ismaiel 
Head Sector of Abu Sultan PS.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC MPIS coordinator & inspection and 
 quality control general director, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
 Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes,...etc
The transformer must be out of service, isolated, 
 and grounded on both sides.
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment
Complete kit of tools
Blower, Voltmeter
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
